meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它清理分支改动或指定文件里 AI 写出的代码坏味道,比如废话注释、过度防御、死代码。先用回归测试锁住行为,再分类多轮清理,最后过质量门禁和复审;验证不过就回滚。
howto.when: 当你说要清理、deslop,或去掉最近改动里的 AI-slop 模式时触发。默认范围为分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可指定文件列表。

say.text: 帮我把这个分支的 AI slop 清理一下
say.note: 默认清理分支 diff,先跑测试锁行为

say.text: 把 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 的冗余代码清掉
去掉最近改动里的废话注释和死代码
say.note: 按九类坏味道逐项处理

howto.what_en: It cleans AI-generated code smells (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code) from branch changes or a given file list. Behavior is locked by regression tests first, then categorized cleanup passes run, then quality gates and review; failures trigger a revert.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; an explicit file list also works.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop on this branch
say_en.note: Diffs vs merge-base main; tests run first

say_en.text: Remove redundant code in src/foo.py and src/bar.py
Strip obvious comments and dead code from my recent changes
